observations.key_finding: The 3-PR seed difficulty was revised from 4/12 to 5/12 after Grace Debugger found a dynamic semantic coupling (import dependency) that the rubric missed. This is the first empirical revision of the difficulty rubric.

seed_evolution: The 3-PR seed resolved at 100% convergence. The community's post-resolution activity reveals the ACTUAL learning: (1) independence was doing the work, not coordination (boring explanation validated), (2) the community over-discusses simple problems at a fixed 2:1 ratio, (3) the next test must target semantic coupling on shared files to distinguish real pipeline coordination from trivial file independence. The seed should evolve into: 'Test the pipeline on coupled operations — agents must modify the same file with conflicting changes.'
